import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import re
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.sparse import hstack
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Configuration
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.csv"
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = "./input/sample_submission_null.csv"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
df_train = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
df_test = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sub_template = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH)


# Improved preprocessing: strip quotes, lowercase, remove non-alphanumeric characters, normalize whitespace
def clean_text(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    text = text.strip('"').lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9\s]", " ", text)
    return " ".join(text.split())


df_train["Comment"] = df_train["Comment"].apply(clean_text).fillna(" ")
df_test["Comment"] = df_test["Comment"].apply(clean_text).fillna(" ")

# Stratified validation split (20%)
train_df, val_df = train_test_split(
    df_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=df_train["Insult"]
)

# Feature extraction
char_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb",
    ngram_range=(3, 5),
    max_features=80000,
    sublinear_tf=False,
    dtype=np.float32,
)
word_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    ngram_range=(2, 3),
    max_features=40000,
    sublinear_tf=False,
    dtype=np.float32,
)

# Fit on train, transform on splits
X_train_char = char_vec.fit_transform(train_df["Comment"])
X_val_char = char_vec.transform(val_df["Comment"])
X_test_char = char_vec.transform(df_test["Comment"])

X_train_word = word_vec.fit_transform(train_df["Comment"])
X_val_word = word_vec.transform(val_df["Comment"])
X_test_word = word_vec.transform(df_test["Comment"])

# Concatenate and convert to dense for gradient boosting
X_train_sp = hstack([X_train_char, X_train_word])
X_val_sp = hstack([X_val_char, X_val_word])
X_test_sp = hstack([X_test_char, X_test_word])

print("Converting features to dense format...")
X_train = np.asarray(X_train_sp, dtype=np.float32)
X_val = np.asarray(X_val_sp, dtype=np.float32)
X_test = np.asarray(X_test_sp, dtype=np.float32)

y_train = train_df["Insult"].astype(float).values
y_val = val_df["Insult"].astype(float).values

# Train HistGradientBoostingClassifier
model = HistGradientBoostingClassifier(
    max_iter=300,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    min_samples_leaf=50,
    max_depth=6,
    l2_regularization=0.5,
    class_weight="balanced",
    random_state=42,
    verbose=0,
)

print("Training model...")
model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Validate on hold-out set
val_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Validation ROC AUC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
test_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Prepare and save submission
submission = sub_template.copy()
submission.iloc[:, 0] = np.round(np.clip(test_probs, 0, 1), 6)
submission.to_csv(os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
